## Objective

This notebook links movement metrics to first-impression ratings. It computes aggregated movement metrics, correlations with first-impression scores, and mixed models including the aggregated movement predictors.

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(car)
library(knitr)
library(tibble)
```

```{r}
dir.create("../results", showWarnings = FALSE)

source("../sources/stat_helpers.R")
source("../sources/questionnaire_analysis.R")
source("../sources/stimuli_manip_check.R")
source("../sources/movement_statistics.R")
```

```{r}
data_imp <- read_csv("../data/data_imp.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
movement_features <- read_csv(
  "../data/all_participants_movement_features.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
stimuli_info <- read_stimuli_participants("../data/stimuli_participants.csv")
```

```{r}
metric_impression_correlations <- build_metric_impression_correlations(
  questionnaire_df = data_imp,
  features_df = movement_features,
  stimuli_df = stimuli_info
)

print(metric_impression_correlations)
```

```{r}
movement_model_outputs <- fit_total_movement_models(
  questionnaire_df = data_imp,
  features_df = movement_features,
  stimuli_df = stimuli_info
)

print(movement_model_outputs$fixed_effects)
print(movement_model_outputs$anovas)
```

```{r}
write_csv(metric_impression_correlations, "../results/metric_impression_correlations.csv")
write_csv(
  movement_model_outputs$fixed_effects,
  "../results/mixed_models_with_total_movement_predictors.csv"
)
write_csv(
  movement_model_outputs$anovas,
  "../results/mixed_models_with_total_movement_predictors_anova.csv"
)
```
